dvids.title: USS John Basilone arrives at new homeport in Rota, Spain
dvids.desc: Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS John Basilone (DDG 122) arrived at its new homeport of Naval Station Rota, Spain, Oct. 14, joining forward-deployed U.S. naval forces operating in Europe.
